reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited § 12.3 expressly states that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, directly satisfying the preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph.
Rationale accurately characterises the clause and notes that fee provisions (§§ 7.1, 8.3) run in our favour and create no third-party matching obligation; no deterministic check failures.
